PILOT AGREEMENT

This Pilot Agreement is entered into as of May 11, 2026 between Tessera Robotics, Inc. ("Vendor") and Brightwater Logistics LLC ("Customer").

1. Pilot. Vendor will give Customer access to its warehouse-routing software so that the parties can work together on a pilot at Customer's Columbus distribution center.

2. Cooperation. Customer will give Vendor's staff access to the distribution center during business hours and will name a project lead.

3. Fees. There are no fees for the pilot.

4. Confidentiality. Each party will keep the other party's non-public information confidential.

5. Governing Law. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Ohio.

TESSERA ROBOTICS, INC.
